title: Static Insulin Secretion Analysis of Isolated Islets
author: Julien Ghislain
materials: Radioimmunoassay kits are used to measure insulin levels. Several kits are available from MilliporeSigma. For the protocol please refer to the manufacturer's instruction.

steps.title: Prepare KRB Stock Solutions
steps.instruction: Prepare four KRB stock solutions and a glucose stock using milliQ water.

substeps.instruction: KRB stock I: dissolve 27.7 g NaCl in 1 L milliQ water.
KRB stock II: dissolve 1.494 g CaCl2 • 2H2O in 1 L milliQ water.
KRB stock III: dissolve 0.648 g KH2PO4 in 1 L milliQ water.
KRB stock IV: dissolve 1.415 g KCl, 1.17 g MgSO4 • 7H2O, and 8.52 g NaHCO3 in 1 L milliQ water.
1 M Glucose: dissolve 18.02 g glucose in 100 mL milliQ water and filter sterilize using a 0.2 μm filter.

steps.title: Prepare Base KRB Solution
steps.instruction: Combine stocks and additives to create the base KRB solution.

substeps.instruction: Combine equal volumes of the four KRB stock solutions in a beaker.
Add 2.38 mg/mL HEPES powder and swirl to dissolve.
Add 1 mg/mL BSA (fatty acid free) without mixing.
Cover with plastic wrap (with holes in top) and incubate at 37 °C for > 1 hour.
Adjust pH to 7.35 using 1 M NaOH (starting pH is ~7.2).

steps.title: Prepare Glucose-Specific KRB Conditions
steps.instruction: Prepare the specific glucose concentrations required for the assay.

substeps.instruction: For 2.8 mM Glucose KRB: Add 2.8 μL of 1 M Glucose per mL of KRB. Prepare sufficient volume for two pre-incubations, static incubation (1 mL/well), and approximately 70 mL for picking and washing.
For 16.7 mM Glucose KRB: Add 16.7 μL of 1 M Glucose per mL of KRB. Prepare sufficient volume for static incubation (1 mL/well).

steps.title: Prepare Incubation Plates
steps.instruction: Set up the 24-well plates for the different stages of the experiment and place them in an incubator with 5% CO2 at 37 °C.

substeps.instruction: Islet picking plates: Add 1 mL of 2.8 mM Glucose KRB to three wells per static sample.
Pre-incubation plates: Prepare two separate plates, each with 1 mL of 2.8 mM Glucose KRB in three wells per static sample.
Static incubation plate: Add 1 mL of experimental KRB to three wells per static sample.

steps.title: Islet Recovery and Washing
steps.instruction: Allow isolated islets to recover and then wash them.

substeps.instruction: Recover islets in recovery medium (RPMI / 10% (v/v) serum / 11.1 mM glucose) for 1 hour at 37 °C.
Wash islets in a petri dish containing 20 mL of 2.8 mM Glucose KRB.

steps.title: Islet Picking and Pre-incubation
steps.instruction: Distribute islets and perform sequential pre-incubations.

substeps.instruction: Pick islets in triplicate batches of 10 into the islet picking plate wells.
Transfer islets from the picking plate to the first pre-incubation plate; incubate at 37 °C for 20 minutes.
Transfer islets to the second pre-incubation plate; incubate at 37 °C for 20 minutes.

steps.title: Static Incubation and Sample Collection
steps.instruction: Perform the final static incubation and collect media and islets.

substeps.instruction: Transfer islets to the static incubation plate and incubate at 37 °C for 1 hour.
During incubation, label two 1.5 mL tubes per sample for KRB media collection.
Prepare and label 1.5 mL tubes filled with 1 mL acidified ethanol (75% (v/v) ethanol / 1.5% (v/v) HCl).
At the end of incubation, collect islets and transfer them to the acidified ethanol tubes; cap and store at -20 °C overnight.
Transfer the media from each well into a 1.5 mL tube, centrifuge at 4000 rpm, 4 °C for 5 minutes, transfer the supernatant to a new 1.5 mL tube, and store at -20 °C.

steps.title: Process Insulin Content Samples
steps.instruction: Process the islet content samples the following day.

substeps.instruction: Retrieve the insulin content analysis tubes (islets in acidified ethanol).
Vortex and centrifuge at 4000 rpm, 4 °C for 5 minutes.
Transfer the supernatant to labeled 1.5 mL tubes and store at -20 °C.
